from tinycsv import parse
import csv, io
assert parse('') == []
assert parse('a') == [['a']]
assert parse('"a\n\nb"') == [['a\n\nb']]        # blank line inside quotes kept
assert parse('"",""') == [['', '']]           # quoted empty fields
assert parse('a,b\r\n\r\nc') == [['a','b'],['c']] # CRLF + blank line
assert parse('x""y') == [['x""y']]          # stray quotes literal, like stdlib csv
# cross-check against stdlib csv on a battery of well-formed inputs
cases = ['a,b,c', 'a,b\nc,d\n', '"Smith, John",42', '"multi\nline","say ""hi"""\n',
         'a,,c', 'a,b\r\nc,d\r\n', '"","x"', 'only', 'a,b,']
for c in cases:
    expected = [r for r in csv.reader(io.StringIO(c))]
    got = parse(c)
    assert got == expected, (c, got, expected)
print('edge cases + stdlib parity OK')
